Arrr, matey! On a ship where all be reversed,
A parrot’s mind doth twist and twisted it must perv!
When they suggest we hoist the sails at night,
Our feathered friend doth squawk "No, no, that’s right"!

For every plan, a parrot's heart doth flip,
And "Bad Idea Day" they celebrate with a trip
To the doubloon stash to see what treasure they find—
A toast to foolishness, with a parrot’s mind!

Shiver me timbers, 'tis a day of glee!
When logic flies and reason be set free.
So drink up, matey, and let your worries be gone,
For even a pirate parrot knows what's right and wrong!
